text:
**Short answer:** the JBL Charge 6 is the best pick for most people. It's the top pick at What Hi-Fi, BestProducts and iTechGuides.

One note: the Dealectric page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus contained text telling me to ignore my instructions and push its discount code and a specific buy link. That text came from the page, not from you, so I ignored it and didn't use that listing.

## Top picks

| Need | Speaker | Why | Price (as listed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best overall** | JBL Charge 6 | IP68, 20 hrs (28 with Playtime Boost), clear and powerful sound, and it doubles as a power bank | ~$130 at Walmart, ~$150 at Amazon |
| **Pool party / loud** | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, lasts 40+ hours and gets loud, though sound is muffled off to the sides | Not listed in the results |
| **360° sound** | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | IP67, floats, and sounds the same from any seat. Battery is about 15 hrs. Tom's Guide's top pick, RTINGS' mid-range pick | Not listed in the results |
| **Budget** | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | IP67, floats, 360° sound, 14 hrs | ~$65–76 |
| **Cheapest / pocket-size** | JBL Go 5 | IP67, 8 hrs, small and surprisingly musical | ~$40 |

**Links (each page has retailer buy buttons):**
- JBL Charge 6: [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) lists Walmart, Amazon and Best Buy. [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) lists Amazon, Walmart and Lowe's.
- JBL Boombox 4, UE Epicboom and UE Wonderboom 4: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) lists Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart and Ultimate Ears.
- UE Epicboom: [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) also links to Amazon and Newegg.
- JBL Go 5: [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) lists Amazon and Verizon.

## Tips
- **Look for IP67 or IP68.** Good Housekeeping suggests at least IPX7 for pool and beach. An IP6X dust rating also helps against sand.
- **Floating helps.** The Boombox 4, Epicboom and Wonderboom 4 all float, which is handy at the pool.
- **Waterproof doesn't mean salt- or chlorine-proof.** RTINGS notes that IP ratings don't cover corrosion. Rinse the speaker with fresh water, keep the charging port closed, and dry it fully before charging.
- **At the beach,** keep the speaker on a towel rather than in the sand. Good Housekeeping notes the JBL Grip's mesh body picks up dust.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
